The page READS only (no row presses Buy, which starts a real Stripe Session); the return band needs a Session of the account's own and is proved by `pnpm probe:credits-return` and the component tests. The Low Sun pass (plan, Themes) is a second run of the same rows with the probe account's theme set to Low Sun (Amonkhet) in its preferences; the sheet has no theme option of its own. `/credits` renders inside the shell's loading screen first, so each `wait` names a thing only the finished page draws.
